北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京今日晴冷，体感 -3℃，记得添衣保暖哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is sunny but cold, feels like -3℃. Remember to dress warmly!
北京.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪多云，气温 8℃，早晚温差大注意添减衣物。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is cloudy, 8℃. Mind the temp difference between morning and evening.

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海晴好，体感 5℃，微风和煦，享受阳光吧！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is sunny, feels like 5℃. Gentle breeze, enjoy the sunshine!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阴天，体感 6℃，有点凉，湿度高，注意防潮。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is cloudy, feels like 6℃. A bit chilly, high humidity, stay dry!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳多云，体感 11℃，温度宜人，出门散散心吧！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is cloudy, feels like 11℃. Pleasant temp, perfect for a stroll!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州晴朗，体感 4℃，早晚温差大，别忘了加外套。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is sunny, feels like 4℃. Big temp difference, remember your coat.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京晴好，体感 3℃，虽有阳光，也要记得保暖哦。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is sunny, feels like 3℃. Even with sun, remember to stay warm.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，体感 4℃，湿度高，记得带伞以防小雨。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy, feels like 4℃. High humidity, bring an umbrella for possible rain.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉多云，体感 4℃，有点凉，出门注意防风保暖。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is cloudy, feels like 4℃. A bit chilly, remember to stay warm and block the wind.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安多云，体感 2℃，略感凉意，记得多喝水。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is cloudy, feels like 2℃. A bit cool, remember to drink more water.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天，体感 6℃，有些湿冷，注意别着凉。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is cloudy, feels like 6℃. Damp and cool, be careful not to catch a cold.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨晴朗，体感 -24℃，超级冷！务必全副武装。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is sunny, feels like -24℃. Super cold! Dress in full winter gear.
哈尔滨.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -24℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳晴天，体感 -15℃，寒意十足，出门多穿点！
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is sunny, feels like -15℃. Very cold, layer up before heading out!
沈阳.alert: ❄️ 橙色寒冷提示：体感低至 -15℃ | 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明晴朗，体感 17℃，阳光温暖，非常适合户外活动。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is sunny, feels like 17℃. Warm sun, perfect for outdoor activities.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门多云，体感 10℃，有点凉，湿度高，带件薄外套。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is cloudy, feels like 10℃. A bit cool, high humidity, bring a light jacket.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛多云，体感 -4℃，风力较大，注意防风保暖。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is cloudy, feels like -4℃. Windy, remember to stay warm and block the wind.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连晴朗，体感 -12℃，风大寒冷，务必做好防寒。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is sunny, feels like -12℃. Windy and cold, make sure to bundle up.
